fixes.en: VF-1S Valkyrie Roy Focker Special\nA high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. After\nFocker fell, his junior Hikaru flew it to defend the Macross.
fixes.why: refit: 'issued to' -> 'for'; 'Hikaru Ichijyo' -> 'Hikaru'

fixes.en: SDF-1 Macross Daedalus Type\nAn alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. Through it,\nhumanity met OverTechnology far beyond any existing tech.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VT-1 Super Ostrich\nA two-seat trainer. Hikaru took it without permission for a\nSaturn date with Minmay, but the Zentradi captured them.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-1A Valkyrie (Hikaru)\nHikaru's VF-1A from the movie. Flying it, he defied Misa's\norders to rescue Minmay, and so the love triangle began.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-1S Valkyrie (Hikaru)\nA high-performance unit for commanders. In the final battle, it\ncharged the foe's ship with the Macross and beat Boddole Zer.
fixes.why: refit: 'commander-class pilots' -> 'commanders'; 'enemy mothership' -> 'foe's ship'

fixes.en: VF-1S Valkyrie (Max)\nA high-performance unit for commander-class pilots. Max flew\nit as Skull Squadron leader and won his duel with Milia.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-4 Lightning III\nDeveloped as the VF-1's successor. When the Megaroad-01 set\nout, Hikaru flew it as the ship's air group commander.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: SDF-1 Macross Armored Type\nAn alien battleship that suddenly fell to Earth. In the movie,\nunlike the TV series, it has ARMD-01 and ARMD-02 as its arms.
fixes.why: refit: restructured TV/movie contrast

fixes.en: Regult\nThe Zentradi forces' most widely used battle pod. Swapping\nweapons suits it to any operation. The troops think it's so-so.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Glaug\nA high-performance unit with big cannons on both arms, plus\nmany lasers and guns. Quamzin's unit, it plagued the Macross.
fixes.why: refit: 'machine guns' -> 'guns'

fixes.en: Nousjadeul-Ger (TV)\nA humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than\na Regult, with shoulder cannons and many handheld weapons.
fixes.why: refit: 'more comfortable to ride' -> 'comfier'; 'heavily armed' folded into 'many handheld weapons'

fixes.en: Nousjadeul-Ger (Movie)\nA humanoid powered combat suit, nimbler and comfier than\nthe Regult. Its design differs between TV and movie.
fixes.why: refit: 'more comfortable to ride' -> 'comfier'

fixes.en: Queadluun-Rau (Standard)\nA high-performance Meltrandi battle suit. Highly mobile, it\nmenaced Valkyrie squadrons with big guns and many missiles.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Queadluun-Rau (Milia)\nMilia's red personal unit, unbeaten and feared even by allies.\nAfter a fierce dogfight, Max got on its tail and shot it down.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Queadluun-Rau (Max)\nThe blue unit Max flew after marrying Milia and growing to\nZentradi size. Paired with Milia's unit, it scored big wins.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Zentradi Soldier\nA Zentradi rank-and-file soldier. Despite wearing only a space\nsuit, at over 10 m tall they can match a Battroid hand to hand.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: HWR-00-Mk II Monster (Ridden by Quamzin)\nA Monster with a delighted Boss Quamzin astride it. Apparently\nhe wanted to imitate a Western he'd once seen.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Vrlitwhai Kridanik\nA Zentradi fleet commander. Tougher than common troops, he\ncan briefly work unprotected in space. A strong fighter too.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Golg Boddole Zer\nZentradi Commander-in-Chief. Core bio-unit of a mobile\nfortress built 120,000 cycles ago; bigger than other Zentradi.
fixes.why: refit: 'Commander-in-Chief of the Zentradi fleet' -> 'Zentradi Commander-in-Chief'; 'than an ordinary Zentradi' -> 'than other Zentradi'

fixes.en: VF-11B Thunderbolt\nDeveloped to succeed the VF-1 as main fighter. Isamu flew it\nwhile hunting Zentradi remnants scattered across space.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: YF-19 Excalibur (Isamu)\nNew engines gave it high mobility but made it hard to handle --\na wild bronco that Isamu called his "little cutie."
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: YF-21 Sturmvogel (Guld)\nA unit piloted by brain waves. To stop Sharon's new unmanned\nfighter Ghost, Guld made a suicide charge that downed both.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: X-9 Ghost\nAn unmanned fighter hijacked by Sharon Apple. Its very high\nmobility toyed with Guld, but his suicide charge downed both.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-11C Thunderbolt\nThe U.N. Forces' main unit from 2040 on. Its forgiving handling\nand easy upkeep kept it the mainstay for a long time.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-17D Nightmare (Standard)\nA stealth unit for special missions, large and heavily armed.\nAfter the Protodeviln appeared, it mainly defended City 7.
fixes.why: refit: 'large airframe with a big weapons load' -> 'large and heavily armed'

fixes.en: VF-17S Nightmare (Kinryu/Gamlin)\nA VF-17 upgraded for commanders. After leader Kinryu died,\nGamlin became leader of Diamond Force and flew this unit.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-17S Nightmare (Milia)\nTo protect City 7, cut off from the fleet by an enemy ploy,\nMayor Milia flew this VF-17S, repainted red.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-19F Excalibur (Standard)\nDeployed to Emerald Force. The YF-19's peaky handling was\ntoned down so that rank-and-file pilots could fly it.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-19S Excalibur (Docker)\nDocker's unit as leader of Emerald Force. Unlike the standard\nunit, it adds four anti-air beam guns for more firepower.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Max)\nMax sortied in it to attack the Protodeviln nest. A high-end\nunit packed with new tech, such as solo fold capability.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Milia)\nMilia's red unit. She fought beside Max in Operation Stargazer,\nand once even sang in it with a Sound Booster fitted.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-19 Kai Fire Valkyrie (Basara)\nA modified VF-19. Its bright red frame has a big speaker and\nspeaker pods, and it roamed the galaxy blaring Basara's songs.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-11MAXL Kai Mylene Valkyrie (Mylene)\nA VF-11 modified for Mylene, its Battroid mode distinctly\nfeminine. She sang with Basara, the battlefield her stage.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-17T Kai Storm Valkyrie (Ray & Veffidas)\nA modified VF-17T. Ray and Veffidas flew it together as\nFIRE BOMBER members, firing up live shows even in battle.
fixes.why: refit: 'as band members' -> 'as FIRE BOMBER members'

fixes.en: Battle 7\nMacross 7 fleet flagship, captained by Maximilian Jenius. Its\ntrump card, the Macross Cannon, got it through many crises.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Fz-109A Elgersoln (Standard)\nA variable fighter for rank-and-file Varauta Army pilots. Said\nto derive from the U.N.'s VF-14, but nobody knows for sure.
fixes.why: refit: 'U.N. Forces' -> 'U.N.'

fixes.en: Fz-109F Elgersoln (Gigile)\nThe Fz-109's commander model. Mainly Gigile's, it attacked\nBasara & co. repeatedly; Gamlin's team downed it over City 7.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Az-130A Panzersoln\nA variable attacker the Varauta Army made by upgrading the\nElgersoln. Its extra power made life harder still for Macross 7.
fixes.why: refit: 'Macross 7 fleet' -> 'Macross 7'

fixes.en: FBz-99G Zaubergeran (Gavil)\nGavil's own unit, a mighty variable bomber with all sorts of\nweapons. Supposedly. Yet Gamlin often downed it in one hit.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Queadluun-Rau (Chlore)\nPersonal unit of Chlore, who leads a rogue Meltrandi fleet.\nPilot skill plus performance let it land a hit on Basara himself.
fixes.why: refit: pronoun-free (Chlore gender unknown in glossary); 'Chlore's skill and the unit's performance' -> 'pilot skill plus performance'

fixes.en: Glavil\nGavil's physical body. It needs so much Spiritia that Gavil takes\na small spirit form, merging into Gavigla to fight all-out.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Gepelnitchi\nLeader of the Protodeviln. To build a world of endless Spiritia,\nhe attacks humans, the "Spiritia-regenerating race" he sought.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VT-1C Valkyrie\nA variable trainer for basic training. Basara flew it to make\nthe Galaxy Whale hear his song, but the whale shot it down.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-17D Nightmare (Liza)\nThe unit Liza stole fleeing smugglers. Whether the bill for it\never reached the Zolan Star Patrol is anybody's guess.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-5000T-G Star Mirage\nA two-seat VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. With a Super\nBooster fitted, it played a key role in arresting the poachers.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-5000G Star Mirage\nA VF-5000 of the Zolan Star Patrol. Liza complained that\nit carried nothing but non-lethal weapons.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-19P Excalibur\nThe unit Basara forced his way into to sing to the Galaxy\nWhale. Whether Ray was billed the rental is anybody's guess.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-22S Sturmvogel II (Gamlin)\nGamlin's own unit in his signature black. To let Basara's song\nbe heard, he fought the poachers without quite knowing why.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VA-C-3 Invader\nThe poachers' main variable attacker, with harpoon launcher\npods to catch Galaxy Whales and whaling mods all over it.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Diving Suit\nThe suit Graham Hoilie wore to fight the Galaxy Whale.\nHarpoon in hand, he fought the white whale to the death.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Cheyenne II\nAn anti-air interceptor Destroid, a redesign of the Cheyenne.\nIt put its firepower to full use in the Macross Attack.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-171 Nightmare Plus\nMain variable fighter of the Frontier fleet. Weaker than its base\nVF-17, but easier for ordinary pilots to handle.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Standard)\nA VF-171 refit to fight the Vajra. Mainly flown by rank-and-file\nU.N. Forces pilots, it fought to defend the Frontier.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-171EX Nightmare Plus (Alto)\nAlto's unit as Sagittarius Squadron leader. Hardly a poor\nperformer, but it couldn't keep up with Alto's skill.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-25F Messiah (Alto)\nCutting-edge unit sent to military provider S.M.S., partly for\ntesting. Alto's F type is built for high-mobility combat.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-25S Messiah (Ozma)\nThe gray unit of Ozma, S.M.S. Skull Squadron's leader. It beats\nthe standard model, and is formidable with Armored Parts on.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: VF-25G Messiah (Michel)\nA VF-25 customized for long-range combat, painted blue for\nMichel. Its sniper rifle and long-range head are trademarks.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Zentradi Main Fleet Supreme Commander. Fearing a myth that\nProtoculture contact saps the will to fight, he deems cultured\nhumans Protoculture, to be destroyed. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)
fixes.why: refit: 'legend' -> 'myth'; restructured: 'he'd destroy cultured humanity as Protoculture' | review: restored that he judges humanity to be Protoculture and sets out to destroy it

fixes.en: Zentradi Main Fleet Supreme Commander, and the central\nbio-unit of his flagship. He grasps a little of Culture, and will\nuse any means, however cruel, to win. (CV: Osamu Ichikawa)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Chosen as a new fighter's test pilot for his superb flying skill.\nHe grew up with Myung and Guld but cut ties after an incident.\nDalmatian High School's wild child. (CV: Takumi Yamazaki)
fixes.why: refit: 'childhood friend of' -> 'grew up with'; 'a certain incident' -> 'an incident'

fixes.en: Chief developer of the YF-21, a BDI-system prototype, and its\npilot too. He clashes hard with Isamu over the next-gen fighter\nrace and childhood friend Myung. (CV: Unsho Ishizuka)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Sharon's producer. Once childhood friends with Isamu and\nGuld, she cut ties after an incident. Meeting them on Eden 7\nyears later, she is torn between the two. (CV: Rika Fukami)
fixes.why: refit: 'a certain incident' -> 'an incident'

fixes.en: A virtual idol who became the galaxy's No. 1 right after debut.\nWith songs that have a hypnotic effect, she controls people\nand plunges Macross City into chaos.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: My profile? Don't dig into someone's past. Forget that, listen\nto my song! Wanna know me? Hear my song and you'll get it.\nHere we gooo! (CV: Nobutoshi Canna)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: FIRE BOMBER's new vocalist. Max and Milia's child, she has\nflown Valkyries since she was little, so she's a fine pilot too.\nAt an age where two boys are on her mind. (CV: Tomo Sakurai)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: An elite pilot who joined special assault unit Diamond Force\nyoung. He saw Basara, who sings in battle, as an enemy, but in\ntime trusts him and the power of song. (CV: Takehito Koyasu)
fixes.why: refit: 'believe in' -> 'trusts'

fixes.en: For his service in the Zentradi war, he became commander of\nthe Macross 7 colony fleet. Though retired, his genius piloting\nis intact, and he flew Valkyries in ops. (CV: Sho Hayami)
fixes.why: refit: 'retired from the front line' -> 'though retired'; 'operations' -> 'ops'

fixes.en: City 7's mayor and a former Zentradi ace pilot. She still sorties\nwhen City 7 is attacked, and citizens back her as their fighting\nmayor. (CV: Eri Takeda)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Leader of FIRE BOMBER. A former U.N. Forces ace, he left the\nmilitary after an incident. Always backing Basara and Mylene,\nhe claims he's 28, which is doubtful. (CV: Masashi Sugawara)
fixes.why: refit: 'a certain incident' -> 'an incident'

fixes.en: FIRE BOMBER's drummer. Taciturn, she rarely speaks, and\nmostly communicates through her drums. A pure-blooded\nZentradi with extraordinary strength.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: As Varauta Army commander, he was to raid Macross 7 for\nSpiritia, but he defies Gepelnitchi's orders to awaken one of\nhis comrades, "Sivil". (CV: Tomohiro Nishimura)
fixes.why: refit: 'Macross 7 fleet' -> 'Macross 7'

fixes.en: He took over the Varauta Army from Gigile and tormented the\nMacross 7 fleet. He dubs all he sees some kind of "Beauty". He\ncan fuse with Glavil into his ultimate form. (CV: Akio Suyama)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Varauta Army Supreme Commander, with the dread power to\ndrain all the galaxy's Spiritia. For his Spiritia Farm Project,\nmeant to give endless Spiritia, he relentlessly hunted Basara.
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: A Protodeviln girl. Drawn to Basara's song, she seeks him\nout again and again. In the end she sings with him and evolves\ninto a self-regenerating Spiritia race. (CV: Akiko Nakagawa)
fixes.why: refit: 'in the form of a young girl' -> 'Protodeviln girl'; 'final battle' -> 'in the end'; 'species' -> 'race'

fixes.en: A taciturn man bent only on killing the white Galaxy Whale that\ntook his right arm and his wife. Oddly, he hit it off with Basara,\nwhich surprised even his daughter Elma. (CV: Joji Nakata)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: A sunny, innocent, slightly ditzy girl from planet Zola who\ndreams of being a pro singer. How she makes it and her name\nrings across the galaxy is a tale for later. (CV: Aya Sakaguchi)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: A high schooler in pilot training who becomes a Valkyrie pilot\nafter a Vajra attack. Born to a famed kabuki line, his gift and\nlooks once had him play female roles. (CV: Yuichi Nakamura)
fixes.why: refit: restructured: 'his gift and looks once had him play female roles'

fixes.en: Alto's classmate, a crack sniper. Motto: "Enemies or women, I\nbring down whatever I aim at." He and Klan go way back. His\nolder sister was also a soldier and sniper. (CV: Hiroshi Kamiya)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Alto's junior. An electronics whiz, he is also special adviser\nto major firm L.A.I.'s tech research division. In battle he flies\nthe EW RVF-25, controlling drone fighters. (CV: Jun Fukuyama)
fixes.why: refit: 'electronic-warfare' -> 'EW'; 'unmanned' -> 'drone'

fixes.en: Skull Squadron leader in S.M.S., Alto & co.'s private special-ops\nmilitary outfit. Ex-New U.N. Forces veteran, he took in Ranka\nfor certain reasons and cares for her. (CV: Katsuyuki Konishi)
fixes.why: refit: 'former' -> 'Ex-'; 'Alto and the others' -> 'Alto & co.'

fixes.en: S.M.S. Pixie Team leader, flying a crimson Queadluun-Rhea.\nIn battle she's a giant Zentradi, but when micronized her body\nturns into a little girl's. (CV: Megumi Toyoguchi)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: S.M.S. Pixie Team leader. Micronized, a genetic anomaly\ngives her a young girl's body, and oddly a childish personality.\nMichel teases her; they always bicker. (CV: Megumi Toyoguchi)
fixes.why: refit: compressed; 'always quarrelling' -> 'always bicker'

fixes.en: Captain of the Macross Quarter and the pillar of S.M.S.\nA former pilot, reportedly as skilled as Ozma, with a broad\nview that reads the tide of battle. (CV: Toru Okawa)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: The Super Dimension Cinderella who met Alto & co. and ran up\nthe glorious stairway to idol stardom. Kira☆. Her love battle\nwith Sheryl over Alto has just begun. (CV: Megumi Nakajima)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: A top idol hailed as the Galactic Fairy. Supremely confident in\nbeing Sheryl, she is extremely proud. Her love battle with\nRanka over Alto has only just begun. (CV: Aya Endo)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: A cyborg pilot who blocked Alto time and again. Emotionless,\nhe saw his missions as his whole reason to exist, but through\nhis time with Ranka he slowly changes. (CV: Soichiro Hoshi)
fixes.why: refit: 'stood in Alto's way' -> 'blocked Alto'; 'gradually' -> 'slowly'

fixes.en: Sheryl's formidable manager, but in truth the mastermind who\nbrought the Vajra to the Frontier fleet. She schemes to use the\npower of Ranka and the Vajra to rule all. (CV: Kikuko Inoue)
fixes.why: refit: 'the entire universe' -> 'all'

fixes.en: An Emulator of the Mardook army. Taken by Hibiki, she met\nEarth culture and learned what culture means. Through Ars's\nsong, she ended the Mardook war. (CV: Hiroko Kasahara)
fixes.why: refit: 'war with the Mardook army' -> 'Mardook war'

fixes.en: A rookie who has dreamed of being a pilot since he was small.\nHonest and earnest, with a slightly timid streak, but once his\nblood is up, he shows a bold side. (CV: Jun Konno)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Raised rich, he wanted for nothing, but bored of a life with no\nthrills, he became a pilot. A seasoned veteran, foul-mouthed\nbut admired as a good big brother. (CV: Tetsu Inada)
fixes.why: refit: 'veteran of many battlefields' -> 'seasoned veteran'

fixes.en: A passionate pilot who deeply loves the sky. His impulsiveness\nlands him in all kinds of trouble, on and off the job. His hobby\nis collecting oddly patterned T-shirts. (CV: Yuki Hayashi)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: Born into a military family where all must serve, she became\na pilot, rare for a woman even there. Bright and friendly to all,\nshe often gives men the wrong idea. (CV: Hinako Sasaki)
fixes.why: refit: 'with men and women alike' -> 'to all'

fixes.en: Trained hard from childhood by her mercenary father, she's\na proven pilot. Perhaps as a single dad raised her, she's rough,\nbut has a feminine side: her hobby is cooking. (CV: Miho Hino)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: An unlucky pilot who joined to be a mechanic, but her aptitude\ntest made her a pilot. A quarter Zentradi, she's always full of\nneedless energy -- her strong point. (CV: Yoko Nishino)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line

fixes.en: An unlucky girl who enlisted to be a mechanic, only to be\nmade a pilot by her aptitude test. Still, with natural cheer and\nneedlessly high energy, she enjoys it all. (CV: Yoko Nishino)
fixes.why: refit: tighter wording to fit 434 px per line
